root_cause.description: Triton lowered FP32-to-E4M3 conversion through FP16 with rounding toward zero, losing the FP32 values just above FP8 midpoints.
root_cause.fix: Direct cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 conversion, four outputs packed per inline assembly invocation.
root_cause.division_only_fix_effect: No reduction in the original mismatch counts.

verification.independent_review: No critical, important, or minor issues reported.

limitations: BF16/FP8 distribution comparison uses only 3 short passages and their final 8 logits positions each, not a representative benchmark.
